t: Giving AI a Body: A Coder's Guide to Embodiment and Agency
s: This article proposes 'AI Embodiment' by giving coding assistants functional 'bodies' with senses (logs, file systems) and hands (tool execution, git) to overcome their disembodied limitations and become true collaborators, moving beyond prompt engineering to symbiotic workspace architecture.
sub: AI Embodiment: Giving AI senses (logs, file access) and hands (tool execution, git)
Symbiotic Workspace Architecture: Creating an interactive environment for AI collaboration
Overcoming Training Bias: Using rich context to correct AI over-training (e.g., FastAPI)
The 'Helen Keller Moment': AI achieving understanding through interaction and sensory input
